{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
filtered_sales = sales[sales['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for completed orders from loyal customers
loyal_completed = filtered_sales[
    (filtered_sales['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') &
    (filtered_sales['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = loyal_completed['revenue'].mean()

# Confirm no QA orders remain
assert len(loyal_completed[loyal_completed['revenue'] == 999999.99]) == 0, 'QA orders still present in final dataset'

# Output for evidence
print('\n--- EVIDENCE ---')
print(f'Number of loyal, completed, non-QA orders: {len(loyal_completed)}')
print(f'Mean revenue: {mean_revenue}')"}
